R-101.description: Handlebars template engine supports lenient, strict and assume-objects modes with a fixed helper set.

R-102.description: The manifest records placeholders extracted from the Handlebars AST for every template.

R-103.description: Template CLI commands create, validate, check and preview templates and build the manifest.

R-104.description: A real annual-statement template renders by id and slug after deploy, plain and PDF/A.

R-105.description: Template validation rejects invalid identity, compilation and sample data; check blocks id/slug changes.

R-106.description: The optional network module supports VPC create and lookup with endpoints and optional NAT.

R-107.description: Chromium renders templates with JavaScript disabled, request interception and the specified page settings.

R-108.description: PDF/A post-processing produces all eight levels with sRGB ICC, XMP and required safety checks.

R-109.description: All five result channels and ping deliver end to end with the documented failure handling.

R-110.description: HTTP callbacks enforce the allowlist plus DNS and link-local/metadata SSRF checks.

R-111.description: CI render regression compares page count, text and appearance for plain and PDF/A PDFs.

R-112.description: A throughput target is agreed and verified with Power Tuning and a load test.

R-113.description: Opt-in alarms and a runbook cover rollback, DLQ redrive, template removal and recovery.

R-114.description: Plain and PDF/A smoke jobs verify each release and the first real template is live.

R-115.description: Bootstrap, OIDC deploy, branch protection and rollback are verified in the real AWS account.
